pairs: On the twenty-fourth day of the month,
in the second year of king Darius,
on the twenty-first of the month,
the word of the Lord came,
factum est verbum Domini in manu Aggæi prophetæ,
by the hand of Haggai the prophet,
Speak to Zerubbabel the son of Shealtiel,
and to Jesus the son of Jehozadak,
sacerdotem magnum, et ad reliquos populi,
the high priest, and to the remainder of the people,
qui vidit domum istam in gloria sua prima?
who saw this house in its first glory?
et quid vos videtis hanc nunc?
And how do you see it now? Is it not,
quasi non sit in oculis vestris?
says the Lord of hosts. For I am with you,
verbum quod pepigi vobiscum cum egrederemini de terra Ægypti:
And act according to the word that I planted with you when you departed from the land of Egypt.
et spiritus meus erit in medio vestrum:
And my Spirit will be in your midst.
For thus says the Lord of hosts:
There is yet one brief time,
And I will move all nations.
And the Desired of all nations will arrive.
And I will fill this house with glory,
Magna erit gloria domus istius novissimæ plus quam primæ,
Great shall be the glory of this house, the last more than the first,
et in loco isto dabo pacem,
And in this place, I will bestow peace,
In vigesima et quarta noni mensis,
On the twenty-fourth of the ninth month,
in the second year of king Darius,
factum est verbum Domini ad Aggæum prophetam,
the word of the Lord came to Haggai the prophet,
Thus says the Lord of hosts:
Si tulerit homo carnem sanctificatam in ora vestimenti sui,
If a man will have carried sanctified flesh in the pocket of his garment,
et tetigerit de summitate ejus panem,
and the top of it touches his bread,
But the priests responded by saying,
Si tetigerit pollutus in anima ex omnibus his,
“If the polluted in soul will have touched any of all these things,
And Haggai answered and he said:
et sic gens ista ante faciem meam,
and such is this nation before my face,
et sic omne opus manuum eorum:
and such is all the work of their hands.
et omnia quæ obtulerunt ibi, contaminata erunt.
And so all that they have offered there has been contaminated.
Et nunc ponite corda vestra a die hac et supra,
And now, consider in your hearts, from this day and beyond,
antequam poneretur lapis super lapidem in templo Domini.
before stone may be placed upon stone in the temple of the Lord:
Cum accederetis ad acervum viginti modiorum,
when you approached a pile of twenty measures,
and you entered to the press,
how I struck you with a burning wind,
et grandine omnia opera manuum vestrarum:
and a hailstorm, all the works of your hand,
et non fuit in vobis qui reverteretur ad me,
yet there was no one among you who returned to me,
Ponite corda vestra ex die ista,
Set your hearts from this day
a die vigesima et quarta noni mensis:
from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month,
a die qua fundamenta jacta sunt templi Domini,
from the day that the foundations of the temple of the Lord have been uttered,
and place it upon your heart.
Numquid jam semen in germine est,
Has the seed been germinated yet?
And has the vine, and the fig tree,
and the olive tree still not flourished?
From this day on, I will bless you.
Et factum est verbum Domini secundo ad Aggæum in vigesima
And the word of the Lord came a second time to Haggai,
on the twenty-fourth of the month,
Speak to Zerubbabel the governor of Judah,
Ego movebo cælum pariter et terram,
I will move both heaven and earth.
And I will overturn the throne of kingdoms,
and I will crush the strength of the kingdom of the Gentiles.
et subvertam quadrigam et ascensorem ejus,
And I will overturn the four-horse chariot,
and the horses and their riders shall be brought down,
a man by the sword of his brother.
says the Lord of hosts, I will take you,
and will set you like a seal,
quia te elegi, dicit Dominus exercituum.
for I have chosen you, says the Lord of hosts.
